subject: general
question: Ram, standing on a railway platform, noticed that a train took 36 seconds to completely pass through the platform, which was 108 m long, and it took 12 seconds in passing him. Find the speed of the train.
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken to pass the platform = 36 seconds

Length of the platform = 108 meters

Time taken to pass Ram = 12 seconds

**Formula used:**

Speed of the train = (Length of the train + Length of the platform) ÷ Time to pass platform
